description: One tool for any cross-section or history; use get_summary for a single ticker's full snapshot. Give fields and filters (any ticker field; names from get_schema), then EITHER date (default latest) OR start+end. One date with filters, tickers, sort_by or a limit screens and ranks; one date with neither returns every asset; a range returns every row in it (market_/macro_ filters keep only dates in that regime). Ranges over ~6 months default to weekly. For big pulls use store_as + fetch_all, then query_data.

append.description: Add rows to an existing store_as table instead of replacing it.

dry_run.description: Range: price it in credits, no data, no charge.

fetch_all.description: Follow every page into store_as in this one call.

fields.description: Columns, e.g. ["market_cap_usd","momentum_rsi_zone"]. Max 60 per date, 30 per range.

held_by.description: Fund ticker or SEC series id.

limit.description: Max rows on one date (default 20, max 500); rows per page on a range.

member_of.description: Index id, e.g. sp500 (point in time).

offset.description: One date: skip this many ranked rows.

page_token.description: Range: a token from page_tokens or next_page_token (same params).

sort_by.description: Ticker field to rank by (one date).

store_as.description: Table name: store rows in SQLite, return only a summary. Read with query_data.

timeframe.description: Default: weekly for ranges over ~6 months, else daily.

name: query
